verdict.rationale: Runway Dev publishes agent-readable docs, and probes confirmed both llms.txt and an OpenAPI 3.1 spec are live. The docs cover each step of the loop: submit a text-to-video request to get a task id, then poll `GET /v1/tasks/{id}` until it reaches SUCCEEDED or FAILED. The response metadata reports the model used and the realized cost in credits, priced at $0.01 per credit. A Dev MCP for connecting coding agents is also documented. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of how the finished asset is retrieved from a completed task (output URL or download step), and independent hands-on corroboration of an agent completing the whole loop.
